note: 0.1.3 APPROVALS, review round 1 (medium): publish writes a moved approval as an Open questions re-ask item that keeps the words that failed the quote check, without a `U-n: approval` marker. Owner rule Q-2 (a message holding a pasted approval line counts for nothing) must cover that item too, or a later session could quote the pasted words and carry them. A typed message or a dialog answer holding the item's text is pasted, whichever part was copied: `words recorded as the user's:` before the words (U-2; U-5 in a dialog answer, with a typographic apostrophe), `as written:` of a line that did not parse (U-3), or `(was U-<k>; not carried:` after them (U-4). Each of these quotes fails approval-quote and moves; nothing pasted is listed as checked. A message the user typed themselves still counts (U-6 carries).
